scope: Snapshot review of the 119-test baseline only; subsequent implementation does not update this preserved mapping.

status_definitions.VERIFIED: The reviewed assertions or retained command receipts exercise the catalog's stated bounded constructed case. This does not complete the broader REQ or prove scientific validity.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Related implementation assertions/receipts exist, but one or more specified discriminating cases, boundaries or integration checks are missing.
status_definitions.PENDING: No reviewed discriminating test/receipt establishes this catalog obligation.

method: Read all seven test source files and the 96 catalog obligations, inspect their actual assertions/reference arithmetic, collect exact pytest node IDs without executing scientific work, and map only relevant evidence. Source/config/test hashes are review snapshot identities; fixtures are embedded in the hashed tests. The aggregate test receipt is not a per-node JUnit record.

data_review_findings.finding: SessionPanel stores dividend event identities flattened by date, losing the source event-to-asset mapping required by the ledger. Exact asset-specific source IDs cannot be recovered from their digests, especially with zero-amount events.
data_review_findings.repair: Preserve asset-aligned source event IDs in admission and the shared panel contract while retaining flattened identities for compatibility. Do not relabel derived aggregate IDs as original source events.
data_review_findings.required_evidence: Constructed simultaneous and zero-amount multi-asset events retain exact identities into the ledger; missing/misaligned/duplicate provenance is rejected.
